entry.title: Astrea: Six-Sided Oracles
entry.content:
Discount Information（Price：9,99 € → 7,99 € [6,99 € ~ 9,99 €]）

All Price Information

Price：7,99 €

Application Description

Astrea é um jogo roguelike que dá uma nova cara para a construção de decks usando dados em vez de cartas com um sistema de "danos" duplo exclusivo: Purificação x Corrupção. Recursos • Sistema de ""danos"" duplo exclusivo: Purificação x Corrupção - Em Astrea, você descobre um novo tipo de sistema de ""danos"". A Purificação pode ser usada para causar danos nos inimigos ou curar a si mesmo. Já a Corrupção pode ser usada para causar danos a si mesmo ou curar os inimigos. Pacifique os inimigos usando a Purificação, ou use a Corrupção em si para liberar habilidades que podem ajudar a virar o jogo. • Sistema de barra de vida dinâmico - Como há habilidades ligadas à sua barra de vida, você pode se Corromper para ativar e liberar essas habilidades poderosas. Só tome cuidado para não se Corromper demais e deixar a Corrupção consumir você. • Não são cartas, são dados! - Construa uma Pool de Dados que combina com o seu estilo de jogo. Escolha entre 350 dados de três tipos: o confiável Seguro, o perfeitamente Equilibrado ou o poderoso Arriscado. Um sistema de tipos de dados composto de alto risco e imensas recompensas. • Personalização de dados - Molde seu futuro trocando as faces dos dados por novas ações, e mude as probabilidades dos resultados a seu favor. • Seis valentes Oráculos para escolher - Cada um tem conjuntos de dados, habilidades e estilos de jogo únicos. De conjuradores habilidosos a beserkers brutos dão a você a chance de superar seus adversários com jogadas inteligentes ou de subjugá-los sem piedade. Há sempre um Oráculo perfeito para você. • Mais de 170 Bênçãos modificadoras para descobrir - Dê ao seu Oráculo habilidades passivas únicas repletas de efeitos que podem mudar suas táticas básicas. Escolha entre as Bênçãos das Estrelas, efeitos passivos com pouca força, ou Bênçãos do Buraco Negro, efeitos passivos potentes com uma desvantagem.

Application Description

Estudantes, professores, escritores, médicos, jornalistas, académicos e profissionais do mundo empresarial usam o Nautilus todos os dias para apontamentos de aulas e reuniões, PDFs anotados, documentos assinados, trabalhos académicos e palestras. O Notes Writer Pro é agora o Nautilus, baseado na nova aplicação Notes Writer. Mantém as ferramentas de escrita e PDF já conhecidas e acrescenta um navegador web inteligente, ajuda de IA para leitura e pesquisa e o Lasso Mágico. Os cadernos de matemática ajudam a fazer cálculos e a criar gráficos, tudo no mesmo lugar no iPad e no iPhone. Escreve e personaliza Cria notas, trabalhos e livros com títulos, listas, cores e destaques. Adiciona imagens ou notas manuscritas com o Apple Pencil. Usa o ditado, ouve o que escreveste, consulta a contagem de palavras e mantém os documentos abertos em separadores. Trabalha com ficheiros de MS Word, RTF, Markdown e texto simples. Lê e anota PDFs Lê livros digitais, artigos e materiais de aula e, depois, escreve nas margens, realça, desenha e adiciona notas, gravações ou assinaturas. Preenche e assina formulários, reordena páginas e digitaliza documentos em papel para os converter em PDFs. Compara dois documentos lado a lado. Mede desenhos à escala e oculta texto sensível antes de o partilhares. Navega e pesquisa Usa o navegador integrado para ler e pesquisar sem sair do Nautilus. Abre páginas em separadores e adiciona sites aos marcadores. Pergunta à IA sobre uma página web, pede-lhe que a resuma ou traduza, ou transforma a página em notas. Usa o Lasso Mágico e a IA Contorna uma passagem ou outro conteúdo com o Lasso Mágico e pede à IA para explicar ou resumir o que selecionaste. Obtém também ajuda para os teus textos: reescreve-os, simplifica-os, corrige a ortografia e a gramática, ajusta o tom ou fala com a IA sobre uma ideia. Captura ideias e volta a encontrá-las Grava aulas, reuniões e ideias. Ouve-as ou cria uma transcrição para encontrares mais tarde os detalhes importantes. Liga notas, imagens e gravações em quadros brancos, reúne pensamentos rápidos em notas adesivas e organiza planos em esquemas. Reúne a tua pesquisa em projetos de estudo. Planeia um livro ou um trabalho longo com secções e um quadro de cortiça para visualizares as ideias. Mantém as fontes junto do rascunho, guarda versões enquanto revês e, depois, compila um documento ou livro digital finalizado. Trabalha com cálculos Usa os cadernos de matemática para manter cálculos e explicações juntos. Explora fórmulas, cria gráficos e vê uma pré-visualização do PDF final. Organiza e partilha Mantém as notas em pastas e cadernos. Adiciona capas aos cadernos para os identificares facilmente. Digitaliza documentos em papel, importa ficheiros de MS Word e de outros formatos e encontra o que procuras com a pesquisa. Exporta para PDF, Word, HTML, EPUB e muito mais. Sincroniza com iCloud, Dropbox, Box, Google Drive ou WebDAV. Protege o teu trabalho A gravação automática, a recuperação de documentos e as cópias de segurança automáticas ajudam a proteger o teu progresso. Usa códigos de acesso para a aplicação ou pastas privadas. As tuas notas em PDF e os teus esquemas já existentes no Notes Writer abrem no Nautilus. entry.content:
Discount Information（Price：9,99 € → 6,99 € [5,99 € ~ 9,99 €]）

All Price Information

Price：6,99 €

Application Description

Defeat slimes, gather resources, and grow even stronger! This is an incremental action game where your attack power and firepower increase endlessly with every battle. Expand your skill tree, combine cards and relics, and wipe out the slime hordes filling the screen in a single sweep! ■ Visible Progress with Every Fight Defeat slimes to earn resources and loot, then upgrade your character and weapons. Enemies that once felt overwhelming can be defeated in an instant as your progress builds up. Experience the fun of an incremental game as you grow stronger, hunt faster, and earn more rewards. ■ A Skill Tree That Grows with Your Choices Choose your preferred path of progression, including attack power, attack speed, and special abilities. The skills you upgrade first will change both your combat style and progression speed. Build your skill tree around your own strategy and complete a powerful build. ■ Explosive Firepower with Cards and Relics Combine cards and relics obtained in battle to unlock new abilities and progression bonuses. Call down lightning, summon boomerangs that ricochet off walls, and dominate the battlefield with powerful special weapons. As your build comes together, battles become even flashier and more powerful. ■ Mercenaries That Support Your Progress and Combat Unique mercenaries from across dimensions track and attack enemies in their own ways. Freeze enemies, call down meteors, and use wide-area mercenary skills. Upgrade and combine mercenaries to create more efficient combat strategies. ■ Weapons That Grow Endlessly Stronger Upgrading your weapons increases both their attack range and firepower. Break through the limits of progression and sweep away the incoming slime hordes with overwhelming attacks. All the power you have accumulated comes alive through explosive, satisfying hits. ■ Simple Controls, Deep Progression Enjoy intuitive controls that anyone can pick up, along with a wide variety of progression systems. Combat is simple, but different combinations of skill trees, cards, relics, mercenaries, and weapons allow you to create entirely different progression strategies. ■ The Secret of No More Slimes!! The once-peaceful Mialreut Gorge has been occupied by a mysterious slime army. Hunt the endless waves of slimes and grow beyond your limits. Can you uncover the true culprit behind this massive chaos and restore peace to the gorge? Game Features - Incremental progression that makes you stronger with every battle - Increased firepower through resource gathering and repeated upgrades - A skill tree that changes based on your choices - Build combinations using cards and relics - Unique interdimensional mercenaries - A wide variety of abilities, including lightning, freezing, meteors, and boomerangs - Weapons that can be continuously upgraded - Cute 2D pixel art - Screen-filling slime hordes and satisfying combat impact ※ Warning: You may lose track of time while watching your stats go up!

entry.title: Watch Tuner Lite
entry.content:
Discount Information（Price：0,99 € → Gratuito [Gratuito ~ 1,99 €]）

All Price Information

Price：Gratuito

Application Description

Watch Tuner Lite measures the accuracy of mechanical and automatic watches. It uses the built-in microphone or headset microphone to record the audible tick of the watch and calculates the seconds-per-day deviation. Works with almost any 'ticking' watch/clock. Use in a quiet environment. Any ambient noise can affect the accuracy of the results. Complete silence is best. Recommended way to record the ticks is to touch the crown of the watch with the headset microphone. You will get the best results using original Apple EarPods. This is a simple version of Watch Tuner application. Not everyone needs detailed information about a watch movement, sometimes only accuracy is important. Watch Tuner Lite uses very similar algorithm like Watch Tuner does but displays only seconds-per-day deviation. If you want to know how much your watch is fast or slow, this application is for you. If you prefer to measure also beat error and amplitude, try Watch Tuner - a bigger brother of this app. If you need frequency diagram look at Watch Tuner Timegrapher - the most sophisticated app of Watch Tuner series.

Add virtual shifting to any indoor training app. BikeControl (formerly SwiftControl) turns a controller you already own into a virtual shifter: Shimano Di2, SRAM AXS / eTap, WHEELTOP EDS, Zwift Click, Zwift Play, Zwift Ride, CYCPLUS BC2, Thinkrider VS200, a Bluetooth remote or a gamepad. WHAT YOU CAN DO ▶ Virtual gear shifting - in apps that support it natively, and in apps that do not ▶ Steering and turning ▶ Adjust workout intensity ▶ Control music on your device ▶ Tune everything around shifting: gear count, ratios, gearing ▶ More? If you can do it by keyboard, mouse or touch, you can do it with BikeControl WORKS WITH Officially supported, built in natively: MyWhoosh, Rouvy, TrainingPeaks Virtual, Strappo Also supported: Zwift, Biketerra, FulGaz and any other app you can drive by keyboard or touch BikeControl applies the gear change at the trainer and sends the resulting resistance to the app, so virtual shifting works even in apps that have no virtual shifting of their own. SHIMANO Di2 AND SRAM AXS Pair the road shifters you already ride outdoors and use them to shift virtual gears indoors. No extra hardware, no adapters. SUPPORTED CONTROLLERS ▶ Zwift Click, Click v2, Ride and Play ▶ Shimano Di2 ▶ SRAM AXS and eTap, every individual button ▶ WHEELTOP EDS ▶ Wahoo Kickr Bike Shift, Pro, V1 and V2 ▶ CYCPLUS BC2 and Thinkrider VS200 virtual shifters ▶ Elite Sterzo Smart and Elite Square Smart Frame, for steering ▶ Gamepads, Bluetooth HID devices and keyboards ▶ Your phone on the handlebar, steering with its sensors OPEN SOURCE BikeControl is open source: https://github.com/OpenBikeControl/bikecontrol PRIVACY ▶ BikeControl only accesses your screen to perform the gestures you configure ▶ All gesture configurations stay on your device ▶ No personal data is collected or transmitted Not affiliated with or endorsed by Zwift, Inc., Shimano, SRAM, Wahoo or Elite. Application Description

Watch Tuner Lite measures the accuracy of mechanical and automatic watches. It uses the built-in microphone or headset microphone to record the audible tick of the watch and calculates the seconds-per-day deviation. Works with almost any 'ticking' watch/clock. Use in a quiet environment. Any ambient noise can affect the accuracy of the results. Complete silence is best. Recommended way to record the ticks is to touch the crown of the watch with the headset microphone. You will get the best results using original Apple EarPods. This is a simple version of Watch Tuner application. Not everyone needs detailed information about a watch movement, sometimes only accuracy is important. Watch Tuner Lite uses very similar algorithm like Watch Tuner does but displays only seconds-per-day deviation. If you want to know how much your watch is fast or slow, this application is for you. If you prefer to measure also beat error and amplitude, try Watch Tuner - a bigger brother of this app. If you need frequency diagram look at Watch Tuner Timegrapher - the most sophisticated app of Watch Tuner series.

Application Description

RadarScope is an AMS-award-winning weather visualization tool that empowers meteorologists, public safety officials, storm spotters, and weather enthusiasts to view a full suite of single-site radar data and related severe weather products. Your initial purchase provides professional radar visualization in a fully native app, free from distracting and invasive practices, with optional subscription packages to add even more capabilities. Whether you’re scanning for a mesocyclone’s tell-tale hook echo, pinpointing the landfall of a hurricane’s eye wall, or identifying velocity couplet, hail spike, or debris ball signatures, RadarScope displays native radar data in its original radial format. You see what the radar sees almost as soon as the radar sees it, with automatic updates every two to ten minutes depending on the radar’s scanning strategy. Your initial app purchase includes the following: • Full suite of single-site radar products for the US, Canada, Guam, Denmark, Finland, and Germany • 10-frame radar loops • Two built-in providers for radar data • Tornado, thunderstorm, flash flood, marine, snow squall, extreme wind, tropical, and other warnings in the US • Selected severe weather warnings in Canada and Australia • Severe weather watches in the US and Canada • NWS-generated storm tracks with hail, TVS, and mesocyclone attributes • Inspector and distance tools • Color palette options for radar data • Weather Pulse data plan integration • Spotter Network integration for storm and location reporting • mPING integration for submitting weather reports to NSSL • Bundled maps with political borders, water bodies, and highways, optimized for low-bandwidth use • Support for widgets and complications • Universal app for Apple platforms, including Apple Watch, and Apple TV • CarPlay support • Family Sharing support RadarScope Pro Tier One is an optional annual subscription that adds more features for tracking severe weather: • 30-frame radar loops • Cloud-to-ground lightning strikes • Special weather statements in the US and Canada • Mesoscale convective and precipitation discussions • SPC convective, tornado, hail, wind, and fire outlooks • WPC excessive rainfall outlooks in the US • Local storm reports in the US • Custom color palette support • Multi-pane display (2 on phones; 4 on larger devices) • Family Sharing support RadarScope Pro Tier Two is an optional annual or monthly subscription that transforms RadarScope into a more complete visualization tool for a larger suite of weather products, including: • Everything in Pro Tier One • 50-frame radar loops • A third provider for US radar data • 30-year archive of NEXRAD Level II radar data • 6-year archive of NEXRAD Level III data • 30-day archive of super-res and non-US radar data • 20-year archive of NWS bulletins • GOES satellite data • Multi-Radar Multi-Sensor (MRMS) data • Real-Time Mesoscale Assimilation (RTMA) data • GFS, ECMWF, HRRR, HRW, NAM, and RRFS model data • Surface observations • ProbSevere layer • Atmospheric soundings in the US • Hail size, hail probability, and azimuthal shear contours with a 30-day archive • More detailed transportation and satellite imagery maps • Custom color palette support for GOES, MRMS, RTMA, and forecast products • Server-sent events for radar and warning updates • Cross-platform subscription sharing on up to 5 devices If you choose to buy a RadarScope Pro subscription, it will be charged to your App Store account. The subscription will be auto-renewed within 24 hours prior to the end of the current period at the same price you originally paid. Subscriptions may be managed and auto-renewal disabled via your App Store account settings after the purchase. Once purchased, the subscription cannot be canceled during the active subscription period. DTN is committed to safeguarding your privacy online. Our privacy policy is available for review at https://www.dtn.com/privacy-policy/ Please visit our web site for more information.
